hotels.title: Brussels City Break near Airport with Onsite Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in the glory and beauty of the Grand Place, and feel yourself getting lost in the intricate details of the city with a getaway to Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport, an IHG Hotel. Positioned minutes from the airport and train station, spend your days devouring traditional Belgian waffles and double-fried frites or admiring the playful art that decorates the city’s streets. Unwind with a delectable, effervescent Belgian beer or wholesome plate at Craft restaurant.
